So Jeremiah stayed in the court of the guard until the day that Jerusalem was taken.
Then Zedekiah the king commanded, and they committed Jeremiah into the court of the guard. They gave him daily a loaf…

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: So they drew up Jeremiah with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon; and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
translations.bsb: and they pulled him up with the ropes and lifted him out of the cistern. And Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard.
translations.kjv: So they drew up Jeremiah with cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the prison.
translations.asv: So they drew up Jeremiah with the cords, and took him up out of the dungeon: and Jeremiah remained in the court of the guard.
